confidence_notes: Oslo restaurant, cappuccino and draft-beer anchors use reported city prices; cocktail uses a smaller current cost-of-living sample. Wine by the glass is estimated from its local relationship to draft beer. Accommodation anchors are bounded model estimates and were not checked against live listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates are based on Oslo-specific reports. For accommodation, use Oslo's high-cost Nordic-capital context, broadly comparable to Stockholm and Copenhagen.
